tasks.short: Book transport and arrange shuttle service for guests.

steps.what: Clarify the guest's airline, train, rental car or shuttle requirements
Find available transport options and actual fare and cancellation conditions
Prepare the exact transport booking with passenger details and total price
Confirm the final itinerary, price and conditions with the guest and approve booking
Book airline or train tickets, reserve rental cars or arrange the selected shuttle
Draft the guest confirmation and request-log update from the actual supplier result
Approve the actual transport confirmation and completed guest-request update
Send the approved transport confirmation to the guest
Commit the approved transport outcome to the guest request log

tasks.design: Configure the guest-service and transport-booking categories of {OTHER} with native supplier connections where available. Gate the actual booking after guest confirmation, then separately review and gate the supplier-result message and internal request-log commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transport searches, passenger entry and guest confirmations repeat details across suppliers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking profiles and supported supplier connections can reuse verified fields.
tasks.still_hard: Prices can expire, reservations can fail and different transport services have different conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Match the journey to the guest and explain costs and restrictions before commitment.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated booking handling; guest advice and booking responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check transport suitability for an itinerary

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported booking connections can reuse passenger and itinerary details; unsupported suppliers still require manual booking and checks.

assumptions: Boundary includes request, options, actual booking, guest confirmation and internal logging. It does not authorize arbitrary bundling or payment beyond guest consent. Shares are provisional; supplier and guest labour are excluded.

s1 captures destination, date, time, party size and preferences during retained conversation. s3 manually verifies passenger names, required identifiers and contact details with the guest; native reuse saves repeated entry only. No passport or health data are inferred.

Suppliers supply service ID, departure, price, availability, conditions and quote expiry. s2 checks relevance; s4 records the guest's agreement to the exact current draft. Expired quotes, changed fares or missing conditions block s5 and return to confirmation.

s5's retained time covers unsupported phone/portal suppliers and booking exceptions. s6 uses actual booking status and reference, manually handles failures, and creates both final artifacts before s7. Native connections are tested first; changed outcomes or recipients require renewed approval.
research_questions: Which suppliers support version-bound booking without silently changing fare or conditions?

already_counted.description: Confirm final booking with the guest
Approve actual outcome message and log update

incremental.description: Maintain supplier mappings and investigate synchronization failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact itinerary, passenger details, price, conditions and guest agreement checked in s4; any change voids booking approval
Final actual supplier-result confirmation and guest destination approved in s7; edits void send approval
Complete request-log outcome and booking reference approved in s7; changed status voids commitment approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes eight search, 7.5 repeated-entry, five booking-handling, five outcome-copying and five send/log hours less three upkeep. Low assumes unsupported suppliers and bespoke records leave only final sending/logging. Guest clarification and both reviews remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist guests with special needs by providing equipment.

steps.what: Discuss the guest's requested assistance and equipment needs respectfully
Check wheelchair or other equipment availability, suitability and collection location
Provide the wheelchair or other equipment and assist the guest safely
Draft the equipment checkout entry from the actual handover
Approve the final equipment checkout details and minimal guest reference
Commit the approved equipment checkout to the equipment register

tasks.design: Configure a native equipment view and checkout form in the guest-service category of {OTHER}. Keep needs discussion, suitability and physical assistance human; record only the reviewed actual handover with a minimal guest reference.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment location lookup and checkout notes repeat basic asset details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment identifiers can reuse location and item details in a checkout draft.
tasks.still_hard: Available equipment may be unsuitable or unsafe for a particular guest.
tasks.human_edge: Listen respectfully and recognize when trained assistance is needed.
tasks.altitude: A small lookup and recording benefit; physical guest assistance is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment registers can support location lookup and checkout capture, but do not assess a person's needs or provide physical assistance.

assumptions: Boundary includes request, equipment lookup, actual assistance and checkout recording where equipment is loaned. Shares are provisional for a service with a real checkout obligation; do not add one just to create savings.

Existing equipment custodians supply item ID, location and actual checkout/return status. s2 verifies availability and condition manually when status is absent or stale; only repeated location navigation is reduced.

s4 manually confirms item ID, handover time, minimal guest reference and expected return from the actual handover. Native reuse saves repeated item entry; no diagnosis or inferred health profile is recorded.

Test native guest-service asset forms first. s5 approves final fields before s6. Physical assistance retains full time, and any additional record requirement for another team must be measured before adoption.
research_questions: Can a minimal native checkout reduce duplicate entry without collecting unnecessary health information?

incremental.description: Check equipment locations and register access

approvals.approved_version: Exact equipment ID, actual handover and minimal guest-reference snapshot approved in s5; changed fields void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: four equipment-location lookup and two repeated-entry hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native registers cover those mechanics already. Same-equipment-register commitment, guest discussion and physical assistance retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform temporary office duties when needed.

steps.what: Perform office reception duties by answering calls and clarifying visitors' requests
Capture the office message, contact details and requested action
Find the correct office department and its handoff requirements
Prepare the internal office handoff message and filing details
Approve the complete office message, destination and filing details
Send the approved office message to the selected internal department
File the approved message record in the shared office request register
Handle physical office copying, document distribution and basic desk support

tasks.design: For temporary reception cover, configure a native office-message form in the request-register category of {OTHER} and an approved contact view in {DOCS}. Capture messages once, reuse their fields for internal handoff and filing, and retain conversation and physical desk support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Temporary cover uses paper notes, a separate directory and repeated email or register entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native request forms and directory views can reuse the same captured message.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual requests and uncertain ownership require an experienced office colleague.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify intent and know when temporary cover lacks authority to act.
tasks.altitude: Less message re-entry during cover; no new financial or personnel authority.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native request forms and directory views can reduce message re-entry during reception cover; exceptional decisions remain human.

assumptions: The statement is broad: this is an explicit provisional reception-cover mix, not a claim that all office work fits it. It includes messages, routing, filing and physical support. Different actual duties must be remapped before estimating savings.

s2 counts manual capture of caller name, reply contact, request, urgency as stated and any confidentiality restriction. It does not assume structured input from the caller. s3 manually resolves unclear destinations; office managers maintain the existing contact directory.

s4 saves reuse of captured fields and fixed headings only; tailored handoff wording remains. Test existing office forms before integration. No call recording, model summary or automatic decision on urgency is proposed.

s5 approves both complete artifacts before separate send and filing actions. Changed message or destination voids approval. Access is restricted to the temporary cover role and ends with the assignment.
research_questions: Does capture-once remove duplicate office messages without shifting corrections to office staff?

already_counted.description: Verify complete message, routing and filing package

incremental.description: Maintain cover forms, directory links and temporary access

approvals.approved_version: Final message and internal destination approved in s5; changed content or recipient voids approval
Final office record fields and access scope approved in s5; changes void filing approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes eight capture/re-entry, 7.5 lookup, three handoff-copying and ten send/file hours less two upkeep. Low assumes direct native capture and routing already operate. Caller conversation and physical office support retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide food and beverage services to guests.

steps.what: Discuss the guest's food and beverage choice and relevant service requirements
Enter the guest's food and beverage order with quantities and service location
Approve the final food order and check any stated dietary instruction
Send the approved food and beverage order to the internal kitchen or bar
Provide food and beverage services to guests and check the delivered items
Prepare the room-charge entry for the food and beverages actually served
Approve the final room charge, served items and authorized guest account
Post the approved food and beverage charge to the guest account

tasks.design: Configure native order capture and kitchen routing in the hospitality-point-of-sale category of {OTHER}, with its guest-account link. Keep choice discussion and physical service human; separately approve the final kitchen order and the later charge for actual served items.
tasks.previous_blocker: Food requests are copied into kitchen instructions and then re-entered for room charging.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item selection and point-of-sale links can reuse the captured order after actual service is checked.
tasks.still_hard: Dietary instructions and substituted or undelivered items require direct verification.
tasks.human_edge: Hear the guest's requirements and verify that the delivered food matches them.
tasks.altitude: Less order and charge re-entry; hospitality and food-safety communication remain unchanged.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: hospitality point-of-sale systems can route item orders and link approved charges to guest accounts; dietary and delivered-item checks remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a room-charge food-service workflow, including order capture, kitchen handoff, physical service and posting. Shares are provisional; complimentary service without a charge has a different baseline. Kitchen labour is excluded and unchanged.

Menu owners supply item ID, price, taxes and availability. s2 manually captures quantity, guest location and stated instructions from s1; no free structured order or inferred allergy is assumed. Unclear dietary instructions are resolved directly before s3.

Kitchen produces prepared items; s5 checks actual delivery. s6 manually confirms served quantities, amendments and authorized guest account, with native reuse of menu prices. s7 reviews the actual final charge after it exists.

Test native routing and room-charge links first. Changed food orders void s4 approval; changed served items or account void s8 approval. No payment-card collection, guest receipt send or automatic health profiling is proposed.
research_questions: Can native order reuse avoid duplicate charge entry while excluding undelivered or substituted items?

already_counted.description: Approve actual served-item charge and account

incremental.description: Maintain menu/account mappings and reconcile routing failures

approvals.approved_version: Complete item order, quantities, location and stated dietary instructions approved in s3; changes void kitchen-send approval
Actual served-item charge, total and authorized guest account approved in s7; changes void posting approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes six order-entry, five kitchen-routing, three charge-preparation and five posting hours less two upkeep. Low assumes existing native order and account links cover these mechanics. Guest conversation, physical serving and both final checks retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native guest-service records and bounded booking connections around personal hospitality.
role.ambitious_version: Capture guest requests once and deliver accurate outcomes while retaining personal care and exception handling.
